svg.text: Clara and the First Beautiful Pokemon — p4
PLACEHOLDER · characters: clara, pip, moxie · seed: None

text.tspan: Clara and Pip peeking around a sparkly bush. In the clearing
beyond, a small fluffy round crystal-moth Pokemon with huge
rainbow crystal wings sits on a flower, gently opening and
closing her wings. Soft sparkly dust floats around her, glowing
in the light. Clara's eyes are HUGE, mouth in a perfect O of
wonder. Characters: CLARA: 5-year-old human girl, short and
round, fair white skin with pink cheeks, long honey-blonde hair
to mid-back with straight-across blunt bangs, huge sparkling
blue eyes, big tooth-gap grin, glittery pink hair bow on the
right side, red and white pokeball-print hoodie, denim shorts,
red sneakers, sticky-berry satchel across chest, big-eyed bright
Pokemon-anime cel-shaded style, default expression is a giant
bossy smile with one hand on hip | PIP: tiny round fire-mouse
pokemon, fluffball the size of Clara's hand, soft cream-orange
